summary: Explains tag inheritance: tags on plays, blocks, roles and static imports are added to every child task (and appended to their own tags), but not for include_role/include_tasks, where tags apply only to the include.
questions: What is tag inheritance in Ansible?
Do tags on a block apply to all tasks in it?

answer_card.title: Tag inheritance
answer_card.answer_md:
Tags set on a **play**, **block**, **role** (`roles:`), or **static import** are added to every child task, appended to any tags those tasks already have.

Tag inheritance does **not** apply to `include_role` / `include_tasks`; there the tags apply only to the include. Use an import if you need inheritance, or `apply` if your playbook uses includes.
